question:
DRAG DROP -
Drag and drop the network assurance concepts from the left onto the corresponding benefits on the right.
targets: allows close to real-time data monitoring
confirms that the network operates consistently with business requirements
offers overall protection and enables analysis of the network in real time to identify security incidents faster
allows the characteristics to be presented as object properties
theory: Streaming telemetry is the transport that gives close-to-real-time push access to operational data; Network Assurance Engine consumes that kind of state to continuously confirm the fabric is behaving consistently with business intent/policy; Cisco Tetration is a workload-protection and analytics platform that examines flow and process behavior in real time to spot security incidents faster; and the (ACI) Data Management Engine is the internal process that stores the fabric's configuration as a tree of managed objects, which is why it's described as presenting characteristics as object properties rather than as an analytics or assurance capability. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — Network Assurance Concepts)
